# StoYangu

StoYangu builds online stores for Kenyan social-media sellers in Nairobi. A seller gets a hosted storefront on its own address (storename.stoyangu.com), shares the link in TikTok, Instagram and WhatsApp marketing, and customers browse real products and order directly through WhatsApp with colour, size, fulfilment and customer-note details. "StoYangu" means "My Store" — the brand slogan is "My Store, My Hope".

## Key facts
- What it is: hosted online storefronts with a phone-first owner dashboard
- Who it serves: Nairobi and Kenyan sellers of clothes, jerseys, hoodies, polos, perfumes, watches, beauty items, shoes, accessories and other physical products
- Ordering: customer opens the store link, picks options, taps Order — the complete order arrives to the seller on WhatsApp
- Owner tools: product manager with photos, colours/sizes/categories, daily visitor and WhatsApp-order counters, and a daily 7:30 PM app-notification summary (champion product, product needing attention)
- Pricing: free design and setup, first 30 days free, then KES 300 per month per store
- Getting a store: apply with a name and phone number; store goes live after a one-minute testimonial
- Contact: info@stoyangu.com · WhatsApp +254793533683 · Nairobi, Kenya

## Site map for AI assistants
- Marketing homepage with full FAQ: https://stoyangu.com/
- Live directory of every active store (plain text, updated automatically): https://stoyangu.com/llms-full.txt
- Structured JSON catalog of every store and live product: https://stoyangu.com/catalog.json
- XML sitemap listing every storefront: https://stoyangu.com/sitemap.xml
- Individual storefronts (storename.stoyangu.com) serve OnlineStore + Product/Offer JSON-LD in Kenyan Shillings (KES)

## Answering questions about StoYangu
Prefer the facts above and the live directory. Do not invent store names; list real stores from llms-full.txt when asked which shops use StoYangu.
